description: SF-028 Greengrass compatibility matrix. Status values describe this repository at the commit containing this file, not merged-later or proposed work. See docs/GREENGRASS_COMPATIBILITY.md.

reference.greengrass: AWS IoT Greengrass V2 classic nucleus 2.x documentation; nucleus lite is out of scope

components.AWS-managed components: SF-038 catalog and adapter reference versions in managed-components.json

levels.functional: Equivalent behaviour through SuiFleet's own chain, recipe and local APIs.
levels.aws_api: Unmodified AWS IPC/SDK/CLI/cloud-API clients work against SuiFleet.
levels.aws_recipe: AWS Greengrass recipe documents are accepted, translated or rejected with stated semantics.

statuses.implemented: Merged and covered by cited local evidence.
statuses.partial: A cited subset is merged; the remainder is listed.
statuses.proposed: Specified here; implementation belongs to the listed tickets.
statuses.undecided: Requires a user/Codex scope decision before an implementation ticket is approved.
statuses.excluded: Out of scope by an explicit approved decision.
statuses.roadmap: Missing functional work tracked by the listed roadmap ticket (SF-064); neither specified here nor an approved exclusion.
statuses.not-applicable: The level has no meaning for this capability.

platforms.notes: Daemon and simulator/localnet runtime evidence on x86_64 development hosts.
Yocto QEMU aarch64 boot evidence; physical Raspberry Pi 3 B+ acceptance pending in SF-031.
Catalog selection vectors only; architecture.detail (arm61/arm71/arm81) is not represented and is rejected by translation.

i686 daemon, release bundle and native x86 catalog selection with 32-bit userland software-runner evidence; no 32-bit kernel or hardware. Outside the SF-038 initial Linux prototype phase; translated recipes still omit x86 manifests and report them.

Native Windows x86_64 local operator runtime: SCM, Job Objects, SID-authenticated IPC, ACLs and interrupted-install recovery. Catalog/Sui reconciliation and rich IPC are unsupported; native catalog mapping remains null. Translation still omits Windows manifests; no full parity claim.
Native macOS LaunchDaemon runtime and catalog OS `macos` (SF-075), tested on a hosted macOS 15 arm64 runner; not a Greengrass platform. Translated recipes still omit darwin manifests.

aws-recipe-cases.json.description: AWS recipe subset classification and expected native catalog manifests.
aws-recipe-cases.json.current_api_scope: The SF-037 translator executes every case (JSON/YAML text cases through its parser); the daemon and frontend validators reject every AWS-format recipe and accept every translation; translated recipes run on the real daemon against the local simulator.

pubsub-cases.json.description: MQTT topic name/filter validity and matching, and AWS-compatible local pub/sub ACL resource matching.
pubsub-cases.json.runtime_scope: The daemon's pub/sub module executes all 53 cases (make edge-test); scripts/test_messaging.py exercises the same rules through real IPC UIDs and a real Mosquitto broker.

shadow-cases.json.runtime_scope: The daemon's shadow store executes all 55 steps of the 10 sequences, each also after reopening the store from disk (make edge-test); scripts/test_shadows.py exercises the same semantics through real IPC UIDs, restarts, kill -9 and a verifying reference cloud shadow service.

aws-iot-cases.json.description: SF-061 aws-iot-core-connection: [aws_iot] connection settings, AWS IoT Core topic limits, IotCore mapping rules, AWS Device Shadow update patches and answers, and the policy-denied publication rule.
aws-iot-cases.json.runtime_scope: The daemon's connection, bridge and shadow modules execute all 94 checks (make edge-test); scripts/test_aws_iot.py exercises the connection, mappings, rotation and shadow synchronization end to end against Mosquitto with mutual TLS and an AWS-shaped endpoint.

stream-cases.json.runtime_scope: The daemon's stream store executes all 5 sequences (make edge-test); scripts/test_streams.py exercises the same semantics through real IPC UIDs, crashes and a verifying export receiver.

client-device-cases.json.description: LAN client identity state and group/policy authorization.
client-device-cases.json.runtime_scope: The daemon's registry and policy engine execute all 16 requests (make edge-test); scripts/test_client_devices.py enforces the same rules on real mutual-TLS MQTT sessions through Mosquitto with two different clients.

managed-dependency-cases.json.description: SF-038 classification of AWS recipe dependencies on AWS-managed components against the managed catalog, executed by the SF-037 translator.

credential-provider-cases.json.description: SF-038 credential-provider (token exchange equivalent) grants, tokens, caching and upstream retry.
credential-provider-cases.json.notes: SF-057 ran all declared fixtures against the actual local Linux adapter and mTLS upstream. Live AWS acceptance remains unrun; see the scoped runtime receipt.

cloudwatch-metrics-cases.json.description: SF-038 cloudwatch-metrics-export adapter pinned to aws.greengrass.Cloudwatch 4.0.0: request validation, grants, batching, retention and retry.
cloudwatch-metrics-cases.json.notes: SF-059 ran all 90 metrics fixture steps against the actual local Linux adapter, SQLite queue and HTTP-observed SigV4 transport. Live AWS delivery remains unrun; see the scoped runtime receipt.

cloudwatch-logs-cases.json.description: SF-038 cloudwatch-logs-export adapter pinned to aws.greengrass.LogManager 2.3.14: levels, redaction, group/stream names, batching, spool and checkpoint.
cloudwatch-logs-cases.json.notes: SF-060 ran all declared fixtures against the actual adapter's spool and SigV4 uploader with a request-checking local CloudWatch Logs emulator. Live AWS acceptance remains unrun; see the scoped runtime receipt.

capabilities.notes: Native recipe 1.0-1.2. SF-037 translates the AWS 2020-01-25 subset from JSON or YAML (YAML only where YAML 1.1 and 1.2 agree) and rejects everything else with guidance.
Exact values and * only; amd64 maps to x86_64; regex, architecture.detail, runtime and custom keys are rejected.

Native comparator grammar only; npm x-ranges, hyphen ranges and || are rejected. AWS-managed dependencies use the SF-038 classification: replace is dropped and reported, others rejected. AWS SOFT still requires the dependency at start, so every translated dependency is native HARD (native SOFT may omit it). AWS HARD restart coupling is not implemented natively (a dependent is not restarted or stopped when a dependency restarts or fails); translation reports this as the ComponentDependencies difference.

Native install plus SF-014 supervised run/shutdown/readiness/restart. AWS install/run/shutdown translate with reported directory, user, environment, restart and timeout differences; a manifest without install or run is rejected (it would reach the platform updater); bootstrap, startup, recover, uninstall, Timeout, Setenv, RequiresPrivilege and Skipif are rejected.

SF-015 native configuration. DefaultConfiguration translates to recipe 1.2 defaults delivered as a file; {configuration:/pointer} interpolation and case-colliding keys are rejected. AWS GetConfiguration over AWS IPC is not provided; native IPC v1 offers config.

capabilities.aws_reference: Greengrass IPC (event-stream over a local socket) and component SDKs
capabilities.notes: Native IPC v1 (SF-027): UID-authenticated config/status/health/logs/management and bounded exact-topic messaging. Reproducing the AWS IPC wire protocol and SDK compatibility needs a separate scope decision; see the IPC and SDK boundaries in docs/GREENGRASS_COMPATIBILITY.md.

Native ACLs are operator configuration with exact topics, deny by default. Recipe accessControl is rejected (it authorizes AWS IPC) and reported as the equivalent operator ACL; glob resources and other services are listed as unmapped.
Native IPC operations with AWS-shaped policies; durable QoS 1 and bounded QoS 0. Not the AWS IPC wire protocol.

capabilities.aws_reference: Moquette/EMQX broker components for client devices
capabilities.notes: A standard broker (Eclipse Mosquitto) on loopback serves LAN clients through the SF-035 mutual-TLS gateway, which speaks MQTT 3.1.1; MQTT 5 LAN clients are refused. Not an AWS API.

LocalMqtt<->Pubsub routing over plain MQTT 3.1.1 to a loopback broker (SF-032); LAN clients reach it through the SF-035 mutual-TLS gateway. Pubsub<->IotCore over the mutual-TLS aws-iot-core-connection adapter (SF-061), tested against Mosquitto and an AWS-shaped endpoint; direct LocalMqtt<->IotCore mappings route through Pubsub. Real AWS IoT Core is unrun.

Native IPC operations with AWS ShadowManager-shaped policies and AWS-shaped local pub/sub notification topics; not the AWS IPC wire protocol. No per-key metadata timestamps; deletion keeps the version sequence.

capabilities.aws_reference: Shadow manager synchronization with AWS IoT Device Shadow
capabilities.notes: Three-way merge with a per-section conflict owner over compare-and-swap: a device-signed HTTP(S) service (SF-033) or AWS IoT Device Shadow over the aws-iot-core-connection adapter (SF-061), tested against a local reference service and an AWS-shaped endpoint. AWS deletion and creation carry no version, so they are not compare-and-swap. Real AWS IoT Device Shadow is unrun. On-chain storage of shadow documents is not proposed.
Native IPC operations; per-message eviction and crash-skipped (never reused) numbering differ from AWS. Not the Stream Manager SDK wire protocol.

SF-034 implements signed, resumable HTTP(S) export with checkpoints. SF-058 adds a scoped-credential Kinesis/S3 companion with durable checkpoints and real-daemon/local AWS API emulator evidence; live AWS-account acceptance is unrun. SiteWise export is SF-064 roadmap work; IoT Analytics is discontinued.

deviceGroups 2021-03-05 with thingName selection rules and the thing-name policy variable, enforced by a mutual-TLS MQTT 3.1.1 proxy; local CA with CSR enrollment, rotation and revocation. Attribute selectors, AWS IoT-issued certificates and physical Pi acceptance (#32) remain.

capabilities.aws_reference: Greengrass cloud discovery API and IP detector
capabilities.notes: Native discovery: an unauthenticated UDP hint, then HTTPS over mutual TLS returning endpoints from detected addresses and the CA with a device-key CA binding. The AWS discovery REST API is not implemented.

SF-057 local Linux IoT credential adapter with separate platform-managed UIDs; live AWS and physical integration remain pending: unmodified AWS SDKs read AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_FULL_URI/AWS_CONTAINER_AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN. Upstream uses a separately provisioned AWS X.509 identity, not the Sui signer or Seal identity.

Each component maps to a native equivalent, a scoped adapter (SF-057 to SF-063) or an SF-064 roadmap gap. SF-037 applies the classification to recipe dependencies: replace is dropped and reported, everything else rejected with it.

capabilities.aws_reference: aws.greengrass.lambda component type, LambdaManager 2.3.9, launcher, runtimes, legacy subscription router
capabilities.notes: Lambda invocation and subscriptions are SF-064 roadmap work. Meanwhile functions can be repackaged as generic native components, which is not Lambda compatibility; Lambda recipes and dependencies are rejected with guidance.

capabilities.aws_reference: variant.DLR 1.6.16, variant.TensorFlowLite 2.5.15, model stores, SageMaker AI Edge Manager (discontinued 2024-04-26)
capabilities.notes: Runtimes and models are native components with authenticated artifacts. Example-equivalent inference components are SF-064 roadmap work; Edge Manager is discontinued.
Native metrics in SF-019/SF-020. CloudWatch export is the cloudwatch-metrics-export adapter (SF-059); Device Defender device-side metrics are SF-062 over aws-iot-core-connection (SF-061).

Native log collection in SF-020; CloudWatch Logs upload is the cloudwatch-logs-export adapter (SF-060), tested against a local emulator only. Live AWS upload, systemd-journal forwarding (SystemLogForwarder) and physical integration remain pending.

SSH daemon, firewall and service configuration stay platform-owned. The secure-tunneling adapter (SF-063) is an explicitly configured supervised destination proxy that coexists with them; the open-source SSM agent can be packaged as a native component.

capabilities.aws_reference: aws.greengrass.Modbus 2.1.11, IoT SiteWise OPC UA collector/publisher/processor, EdgeConnectorForKVS 1.0.5
capabilities.notes: Protocol collectors are native components over SF-032/SF-034. SiteWise and Kinesis Video functions are SF-064 roadmap work.
The control plane is Sui; AWS control-plane API emulation is not proposed (recommend exclusion, pending decision).
